graham.brief:
Somebody has been at the Denver number since Monday. The spread has moved a point toward the Rams. Denver's move is the fact here.

Denver takes the throw away, and the Rams have the 4th-best pass defense in the league. Both secondaries have held up, and that tends to keep Denver at the Rams small. So the work on the Rams at Denver moves down a level, to the players.

The Rams rarely use play-action, and Denver has been hard to fool with it. Bo Nix is the starter who's played 100% of the snaps. They've set J.K. Dobbins at 12.5 rush attempts, well above the 9 he's averaging.

Set the market beside it and the Rams mostly rhymes. The Rams are favored by 1.5 with a 44 total. Neither my numbers nor the price finds an edge in Denver. Stafford's attempts line opened 34 and is 33.5 now. Watch whether the Rams come out throwing over the first two series as often as all season.
